environment_shim.prelude:
local ffi = require('ffi')
ffi.cdef[[uint32_t GetModuleFileNameW(void *module, uint16_t *path, uint32_t capacity);]]
local path = ffi.new('uint16_t[32768]')
local length = ffi.load('kernel32').GetModuleFileNameW(nil, path, 32768)
assert(length > 0 and length < 32768)
BingusRuntime = {hashes = {['sha256:' .. ffi.string(path, length * 2)] = arg[2]}}
environment_shim.why: Wine bcrypt faults in BCryptDestroyHash (execute access violation) for the unmodified upstream too; the one module_hash call is served from the runtime cache seeded with the SHA-256 computed by Python
